properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 12:44PM EDT until September 13 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
FFWOKX

The National Weather Service in Upton has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Middlesex County in southern Connecticut...
New London County in southern Connecticut...

* Until 230 PM EDT.

* At 1244 PM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain falling across the warned area. Between 1 and 3.5 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in
1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Jewett City, Norwich, New London, Colchester, Groton, Salem,
Mystic, Waterford, East Lyme, Ledyard, Griswold, East Haddam, Old
Lyme, Lebanon, Preston, Lisbon, Sprague, Bozrah, Voluntown and
Lyme.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Excessive runoff from heavy rainfall will cause flooding of urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as other drainage
areas and low lying spots.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 9:57AM EDT until September 13 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Upton has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in New Jersey...

Saddle River near Lodi affecting Bergen County.

For the Saddle River...including Lodi...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Saddle River near Lodi.

* WHEN...From this morning to this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 5.5 feet, Saddle River begins to overflow into the
back parking lot of the Boys and Girls club.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 AM EDT Sunday the stage was 5.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon to a crest of 5.7 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage this afternoon.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 6.1
feet on 01/27/1996.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 400 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 10:29AM MST until September 13 at 1:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Havasupai Creek This includes the Colorado River between river
miles 156 and 158

Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 130 PM MST.

* At 1029 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area, just north of Supai along Havasu
Creek. Between 0.5 and 0.75 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned
area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beaver Falls, Mooney Falls, Little Navajo Falls.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Second Chance Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Sinyella Canyon, Colorado River, Little Coyote Canyon and Havasu
Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Get out of washes and creeks if you are camping or hiking! Flooding
is occurring or imminent and will inundate creeks and washes.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 1:30 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 1:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 1:22PM EDT until September 13 at 2:15PM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:
SVRBUF

The National Weather Service in Buffalo has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Erie County in western New York...
Southern Niagara County in western New York...
Southwestern Orleans County in western New York...
Northwestern Genesee County in western New York...

* Until 215 PM EDT.

* At 122 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Sanborn, or
near North Tonawanda, moving east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Niagara Falls, North Tonawanda, Lockport, Batavia, Tonawanda,
Amherst, Medina, Albion, Grand Island, and Pendleton.

This includes Interstate 90 between exits 48 and 48A.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
